status: fixed before running this new stopping-policy computation; not preregistered; historical project outcomes already available
seed_choice: existing archive reference replicate index 0; no seed search
initial_scale: population SD (ddof=0) of the first 12 revealed responses, fixed thereafter
constant_initial_batch_guard: if initial_scale <= 1e-12, set delta=0 and disable model-based stopping for the campaign; retain the unchanged acquisition model's unit-scale fallback; report budget-limit outcome
unseen_bound: max over remaining candidates of posterior latent mean + 1.96 * posterior latent SD <= current observed best + delta; no random tie jitter in stopping bound
joint_check: minimum observations satisfied AND nonconstant initial batch AND plateau AND unseen_bound
decision_order: model stop if the second consecutive eligible joint check passes; otherwise budget-limit stop at 60; otherwise continue
uncertainty_scope: 1.96 is the unchanged acquisition coefficient and a pointwise heuristic model bound, not a simultaneous bound or a calibrated 95% guarantee; posterior model error is unquantified
delta_scope: dimensionless operational tolerance of 0.10 initial-batch SD; not validated analytical precision, not a yield percentage-point difference, not a chemically established minimum relevant improvement
chemical_confirmation: independent repeats of the selected working condition and relevant close alternatives, with verified product quantification, are required before any chemical optimum claim
observation_boundary: only selected batch responses are passed to policy.observe; acquisition, delta, plateau, and stopping never receive full-pool responses or a known optimum
reporting: show selected rows and their archived responses as computationally revealed values; no actual lab chronology, new execution dates, or lab savings claimed; keep all original workbooks and earlier archives unchanged
heldout_diagnostics: not used for decisions and not included in NH/OH PDF tables; no NH/OH full-pool optimum success claims
